description: Ministry of Public Security - Amended the Registration of Persons Regulation No. 1 of 2017 Published in Gazette Extra No. 2021/28 of May 31, 2017 were Approved by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on September 19, 2023
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval of regulations made under the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the amendment of existing regulations (Registration of Persons Regulation No. 1 of 2017) through proper legislative procedures. While it mentions a government minister and ministry, the primary focus is on the regulatory framework and legal process rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
